slices.focus: Two palliative practices adopt Tasha's referral packet; group attendance stabilizes across county sites
slices.summary: Tasha's clinic outreach crosses a milestone when two palliative practices agree to use her bereavement referral packet and designate named point people for handoffs. The result is measurable: monthly groups in Cary and southeast Raleigh fill more consistently without the swings that used to plague them. Tasha recognizes this as the first time external partners have adopted her tools, proving the program real beyond her own department. The agent helps her frame the update around 'mechanism' (the reporting shows cause and effect between cleaner handoffs and steadier turnout), plan partner-specific reporting for leadership, add a simple referral-quality checkbox, and stabilize before expanding further. Tasha plans to write the update with reporting first, attendance second, and a clear 'stabilize these two partners' stance.
